method.executionClock: CPU encode + submit + queue completion; excludes output/timestamp readback
method.compileClock: synchronous graph.compile; deferred pipeline compilation may appear in first execution
method.gpuClock: separate profiled executions sum node timestamp durations when available; normal wall-clock repetitions remain unprofiled
method.uploadClock: buffer.write calls + queue completion, excludes allocation
method.cpuReference: independent JavaScript correctness oracles; single run, not optimized library throughput
method.memory: graph allocated transient resources; not driver/process peak memory
method.cache: shared test device; pipeline caches are not cleared; first execution is not a guaranteed cold-driver measurement
method.envelope: bounded workload observations only; no latency threshold or speed advantage is asserted
method.cpuReferenceCaveat: Registration and unmixing reference durations measure analytic validation only; other workloads use simple independent CPU reductions/solves, not optimized native libraries.

metadata.sourceManifestScope: SHA256 of raster runtime and benchmark TypeScript files; other dependencies identified by sourceRevision and working-tree integration. Manifest identifies source bytes, not a claim that revision was clean.
metadata.result: 20 of 20 workload records completed and checked; Vitest 1 benchmark test passed
